mcp_tools.name: knowledge_graph_design
mcp_tools.title: Knowledge graph design
mcp_tools.description: Submits a knowledge-graph design record (schema and modeling, provenance, immutable history, storage and query retrieval, portability and ownership, privacy and red lines) and returns a deterministic KNOWLEDGE_GRAPH_DESIGN_SOUND / KNOWLEDGE_GRAPH_DESIGN_NOT_SOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed per-assertion provenance and origin-classification coverage checks, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared design; it stores and queries no graph.

inputSchema.description: The knowledge graph design manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and row schemas).

assertions.description: Declared assertions: {name, source_declared, date_declared, confidence_declared, origin_classified}.

expect.notes: All checks pass. Computed spot checks: declared_core_type_count=15, assertions_count=1, provenance_coverage=1.000000, origin_classification_coverage=1.000000.
